Google ML Kit.basis: PRNS Chat uses the Android libraries for in-app scanning. Google documents both the bundled barcode model and Play services scanner integration. The Google APIs and ML Kit terms apply to the libraries and models. Scans run on-device. Google may receive performance and usage metrics and provide updates. This review covers using the client in this Android application.

Google Android SDK client terms.basis: The four Google Maven AARs are Android client-library inputs to PRNS Chat. Google documents packaging the client libraries in apps. Android SDK license sections 3.1–3.5 restrict SDK use and redistribution. The project release-policy decision for this app-specific integration is pending.
